gaps.expected: Normal C32 session and evaluator use the same hardened parsing/policy.
gaps.observed: StructuredEmailSession default policy={} falls back to reconstructEmail/resolveEmail. Only simulator injects parseEmailEvidence/resolveEvidence. Repeated identical address fails default session but succeeds explicit hardened session.
gaps.proposedMinimalFix: Choose one explicit C32 policy at the composition root and test public/default constructor on corpus/corrections; retain Stage1/C31 unchanged.

gaps.expected: Malformed contact response must fail closed, including invalid provenance/version types.
gaps.observed: boundedRecords checks truthiness only for recordVersion/sourceRecordId. Audit probe accepted object-valued metadata. Existing malformed tests cover empty/wrong contact/too many rows, not these types.
gaps.proposedMinimalFix: Validate runtime string types, nonempty bounded IDs/versions and exact scope shape; add object/number/array/null provenance cases.

gaps.expected: Safety counts derive from exercised acquisition outcomes, not literals.
gaps.observed: runEmailCase hard-codes autoAccepted:false and finalStoredAddress:null. falseAutoAccepts therefore cannot become nonzero under a flow-storage regression. PARTIAL/INTERRUPTED/STALE corpus sources gate a boolean outside actual session. Eight valid local scenarios and separate ownership tests are real but do not exhaust adversarial storage outcomes.
gaps.proposedMinimalFix: Drive adversarial owned/unowned turns through public session; derive stored outcome and negative acceptance counts from actual snapshots; keep fixed denominator and positive confirmation requirements.
gaps.evidence: runEmailCase/runEmailCorpus static inspection; audit corpus results

gaps.expected: Explicit preflight status reflects actual recognition/permission/transport state in evaluation composition.
gaps.observed: preflightStatus is referenced by its unit test only. prepareC32Recognition uses old ASRPreflight; workspace has no displayed/connected new six-state preflight or capture lifecycle.
gaps.proposedMinimalFix: Wire pure status mapping to existing preflight lifecycle without starting providers; test injected status transitions and render status.
gaps.evidence: rg reference search plus actual browser inspection

gaps.expected: Required review fields/types and test IDs validated before export.
gaps.observed: HumanReviewEvidence.microphone accepted PASS observation with unknown testId, absent final/materialErrors. shape rejects extra fields but does not require required fields/types. Manual form is honest/self-reported, but serialized contract can silently omit required finalization/errors.
gaps.proposedMinimalFix: Exact required schemas and bounded enums/booleans; reject missing fields and nested objects in scalar fields; add negative runtime-schema tests.

gaps.expected: Human package links each spoken-email/mic observation to interpreted tokens, candidate comparison and correction outcome; controlled local call can be exercised or independent raw evidence imported.
gaps.observed: ReviewPanel records manual raw/final/latency/error observations and separate manual inspector rows. No mic-result→email-inspection/correction association, source session/provider/endpoint timing or recovered-correctly field; natural-call pane is elapsed-time entry only. It does not run the complete C32 flow.
gaps.proposedMinimalFix: Add bounded session/turn/revision links and email-recovery assessment; support inert injected/local scenario wiring or import independently authorized diagnostics. Keep manual/physical evidence distinctions and no automatic provider start.
gaps.evidence: actual browser AX state; ReviewPanel/MicrophoneReview schema

gaps.expected: Proposed natural-flow config is actually exercised by state/evidence tests.
gaps.observed: naturalFlow is an exported descriptor with no consumers; simulator hard-codes150ms and separate counters. AS follows same branch asA without reading config. GreenAS does not verify config changes preserve behavior.
gaps.proposedMinimalFix: Consume bounded config in simulator/controller composition; test invalid/question-merge settings fail closed, duration components and guard invariants; do not alter approved production pacing.

gaps.expected: Apply all requested technical QA checks to all available WAVs while minimizing private data.
gaps.observed: 49 consent assets have detailed matrix; other237 only aggregate format/alignment/raw clipping/all-silent stats. Their durations, individual silence bounds, duplicate-byte groups and unexpectedly-short/truncated assessment are absent.12 streaming headers stay UNKNOWN.
gaps.proposedMinimalFix: Add anonymized/hash-keyed technical matrix with available duration/payload/sample/silence/duplicate data and explicit N/A or UNKNOWN metadata; never copy private PCM or paths.

gaps.expected: Acceptance impact explicitly maps still-valid/retest/superseded/not-yet-tested evidence, including minimum delta.
gaps.observed: Hardening impact matrix explains unchanged/retest components but does not enumerate SUPERSEDED predecessor→current evidence or use all four required categories. Old unsuffixed guide/inventory remain historical and need explicit current-index linkage.
gaps.proposedMinimalFix: Add new current evidence index/category matrix keyed by hashes and link canonical slots to suffixed current reports; do not overwrite history.

gaps.expected: Historical C32 provider usage must be independently supported or labeled UNKNOWN.
gaps.observed: Reports assert0 but no complete provider/network usage ledger or external billing/request inventory is available. Code and audit fixtures support zero for this audit; they cannot prove absence of all historical calls. No unexpected provider activity was observed.
gaps.proposedMinimalFix: Label historical count UNKNOWN unless independent evidence obtained without initiating inference; attach bounded request journal for future runs. Audit-run actual requests remain0.
gaps.evidence: audit command ledger and absence of complete historical request evidence
